acceptance.given: SM-1 witness validation runs against the frozen Atomic Obligation set and its Exact Cover records.

oracle.expected: The validator emits a current artifact showing every Atomic Obligation ID mapped to all required witnesses, with 100% coverage and zero missing witnesses.
forbidden: Any Atomic Obligation is absent from the witness map.
The report claims complete coverage while omitting a required witness.
oracle.observable: A machine-readable witness-coverage report is reconciled bidirectionally against the frozen Atomic Obligation inventory and records complete required-witness coverage.

acceptance.then: The witness report proves that every frozen Atomic Obligation has its required witnesses.
acceptance.when: SM-1 witness validation is executed against the frozen Atomic Obligation inventory.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate the witness map so one frozen Atomic Obligation lacks a required witness; validation must fail with the missing obligation and witness identified.

affected_subjects: Atomic Obligations and their required witnesses
slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or verify SM-1 witness reconciliation so the validator enumerates every frozen Atomic Obligation, checks each required witness bidirectionally, and rejects omissions.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing conformance input and report schemas; rollback only the witness-reconciliation logic.

slice_hint.state_transition: unvalidated Atomic Obligation witness set -> validated 100% bidirectional witness coverage or explicit failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator exits success only when every frozen Atomic Obligation has every required witness and no orphan or omission is reported.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has reached the successful-result state and includes the snapshot binding under evaluation.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result contains an independently computed snapshot verification record whose subject, digest or equivalent identity, and comparison outcome match the bound snapshot.
forbidden: The result merely echoes the snapshot without an independent verification computation.
The snapshot verification is missing or unverifiable.
oracle.observable: The replay-result artifact contains a distinct snapshot-verification field or record and a passing comparison against the bound snapshot.

acceptance.then: The successful Replay Result independently verifies the snapshot.
acceptance.when: A Replay Result is finalized as successful and its snapshot verification is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or replace the independent snapshot-verification record while leaving the replay result marked successful; validation must reject the result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful Replay Result assembly to compute and persist an independent snapshot verification and have validation compare that record with the bound snapshot.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep Replay Result fields backward-compatible; only add or restore the independent verification assertion and preserve existing evidence records.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful Replay Result with unverified snapshot -> successful result with independently verified snapshot or rejected result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success is accepted only when an independently produced snapshot verification record is present and passes comparison with the bound snapshot.

acceptance.given: Pinned inputs and their baseline coverage result are available for a clean fresh-checkout replay.

oracle.expected: The coverage result produced by executing the pinned inputs in a fresh checkout is byte-for-byte or schema-equivalent identical to the pinned-input baseline coverage result.
forbidden: The fresh-checkout coverage result differs from the pinned-input baseline.
The replay cannot produce a coverage result from the pinned inputs.
oracle.observable: A fresh-checkout replay artifact records the pinned input identity and a coverage-result comparison with an equal outcome.

acceptance.then: The fresh checkout produces the same coverage result as the pinned-input baseline.
acceptance.when: Pinned inputs are executed in a fresh checkout and the resulting coverage artifact is compared with the baseline.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Change one pinned input or its resolved tool version so the fresh-checkout coverage result differs from baseline; replay validation must fail deterministically.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make fresh-checkout replay recompute coverage from pinned inputs and compare the complete result against the pinned baseline, including input identity and coverage payload.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing baseline and replay artifact schemas; rollback only the fresh-checkout coverage comparison behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Fresh checkout with pinned inputs but unproven coverage -> replayed coverage compared to baseline and accepted only on equality.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation succeeds only when a clean checkout reproduces the baseline coverage result with matching pinned-input identity; any drift fails.

acceptance.given: The frozen historical artifact membership and paths are captured before repair or runtime activity.

oracle.expected: A pre/post byte comparison over exactly the frozen historical artifact paths is identical, while any new repair or runtime evidence is appended only outside those frozen files.
forbidden: Any frozen historical artifact byte changes.
A comparison that omits a frozen artifact or silently includes only a subset.
oracle.observable: A byte-integrity report enumerates every frozen historical artifact path and records identical pre-operation and post-operation hashes or bytes.

acceptance.then: Frozen historical artifact bytes remain unchanged.
acceptance.when: Repair or runtime activity that could affect frozen historical artifacts completes and byte preservation is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Modify one byte in a frozen historical artifact before the post-operation comparison; the byte-integrity check must fail and identify the changed path.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Capture frozen artifact hashes before operation, re-read the exact frozen membership afterward, compare bytes or cryptographic digests path by path, and reject modifications while permitting append-only evidence outside the frozen set.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve frozen artifact manifests and existing governance outputs; rollback only integrity-check enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen historical bytes established -> operation executes -> exact byte identity confirmed or operation rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The guard passes only when every frozen historical artifact has identical pre/post bytes and no frozen path is omitted.
